observations: Seven columns align across all six rows. 42 native cells are measured; actual heights are 228/229px, the 1px raster rounding difference is below 1dp.
0/1, 2/5 and 99/100 are completely visible in gold; dates are larger than the fraction text. No ellipsis, horizontal clipping or font suppression is visible.
The current date is softly shaded, selected-date border preserves the common height, and real adjacent-month day numbers use reduced contrast.
All three filter dialogs display the full totals and result counts 1/0/1, 5/2/3 and 100/99/1 without clipping. The actual taps/open/close actions are linked in raw Appium evidence.
Calendar and modal remain scrollable; header/bottom navigation are separated from content. The dev-client Tools bubble is a verification-build overlay, excluded from the product visual conclusion.
